Estimate which month the snapshot describes. Use only the figures supplied plus your general knowledge of economic history.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"year": yyyy, "month": m, "confidence": c, "cues": ["...", "..."]}
Rules: year is an integer from 2007 to 2026; month is an integer from 1 to 12; c in [0, 1] is your confidence that the guess is within 6 months of the truth; 1 to 3 short cues citing the inputs.
text:
Key features: the policy rate is high relative to its 3-year average but falling (-1.0 over 3m and over 12m). Yields fell sharply (-1.5 over 3m). Unemployment is up 1.0 over 12m. Headline and core CPI are low relative to their 3-year average. Gold is strong. The stock-bond correlation is positive.

This looks like late 2024, when the Fed had cut in September, November and December 2024. But yields rose in Q4 2024, so the sharp 3m fall in yields doesn't fit. Fall 2024 (September or October) is possible, with yields down in the summer, but the 3m change at the end of September 2024 would be about -0.5 to -1 at the 10y.

An alternative is mid-2025 to late 2025. At end of October 2025 the Fed had cut in September and October, and the 2y was down about 1.5 over 3m. The 12m change in the policy rate would be about -1 (5.33 to 4.0 roughly vs a 3y window). Gold up strongly over 6m and 12m fits late 2025. Unemployment at +0.5 with a 12m change of +1.0 fits 2025 (4.1 to 4.4 or 4.6). Payrolls weak at -1.0 fits too. CPI z-scores of -1.5 fit, since inflation is below the 2022-2023 values. The Baa spread z of -1.0 fits tight spreads. The 1m Treasury return of +1.5 suggests a strong bond month. September 2025 saw yields drop, and the 10y fell in October as well. The VIX is -0.5 and equities were modest, so it is probably September or October 2025. Since 1m equity is +0.0, which is weak, that points to something less like October (S&P +2.3%). Equities in November 2025 were flat (+0.2%) and Treasuries rose about 1%. The 3m change in yields would be down in November, as the 10y went from 4.4 at end-August... hmm, it was 4.5 in August and 4.0 in November. I'll pick November 2025.
